security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: Veil2 stores files in an encrypted vault, browsable as a list rather than a single block to decrypt. Built for and run on macOS (Requirements §2.1); Windows and Linux are not built, not scheduled, and not claimed.
